name: Menethil’s Gift
shortDescription: Menethil’s Gift, a Classic-era setting in the Ras Frostwhisper research story.
body: This location appears in the Classic quest sequence. Cold grey Lordaeron stone, low old-city Gothic arches and worn flagstones in Stratholme’s Undead-side. A restrained ground sigil marks Menethil’s Gift. The sigil’s reported placement in Baron Rivendare’s quarters is secondary and remains an in-client verification gate. The scene is interpretive; the story-tour marker and theater staging assert no exact geographic coordinates.
